propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py::test_install_from_sdist_preserves_commit emits Python 3.14 DeprecationWarning because TarFile.extractall() is called without an explicit filter parameter
CPython 3.12.13 and later versions warn that tarfile extraction without an explicit filter will change behavior in Python 3.14
The test fixture's generated sdist contains five relative regular files with mode 0644 and no special entries, making it safe for data_filter
TarFile.extractall() must be called with filter="data" to suppress the warning and align with Python 3.14's safe default behavior
The test's provenance assertion and wheel rebuild remain unchanged when using data_filter, confirming the fix does not alter observable behavior
